description: Get or patch the accumulated files, symbols, decisions and neighbors for a job (M-073), so a resume does not rediscover context it already has. Pass jobId to read or extend that job's own set (also what its next resume prompt injects); omit it to use the standalone, per-workspace set for an inline chat session with no job. action=set merges arrays in (dedup, capped) — it never replaces the whole set.

jobId.description: Omit for the standalone, inline-session working set
